Super Typhoon Bavi Approaches US Pacific Islands

A super typhoon, Super Typhoon Bavi, is forecast to bring strong winds and heavy rainfall to the US Pacific islands on Monday. The storm's eye is expected to pass over the area, with maximum sustained winds of up to 280 km/h and gusts of 333 km/h. Evacuations have been ordered in Guam as the storm approaches.
